question: "The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years in such a manner as the State may, by law, determine" has been added to the Indian Constitution under _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 21A.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 21A was added to the Indian Constitution through the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002.**
 
• The amendment made free and compulsory education a fundamental right for children between the ages of six and fourteen.
 
• The amendment also mandated that the State shall provide infrastructure and resources to ensure that every child has access to quality education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 19A pertains to the right to freedom of speech and expression.
 
• **It offers freedom of speech, which is the ability to freely and fearlessly express one's opinions in writing, orally, electronically, through the media, or through the press.**
 
• Press freedom is an aspect of freedom of expression.
 
• It also includes websites and blogs.
